title: Group trip planning app
summary: Plan a group holiday — dates, budget, itinerary, votes — in one shared space.
whyTempting: Group trip planning is genuinely painful and everyone has a horror story.
whyItFails: Infrequent use. People take one or two group trips a year. Only one planner per group. One organiser does the work; others won't install an app. Revenue leaks to booking sites. Bookings happen on Airbnb and airlines, not in your app.
whatWouldChange: Embedding into existing chats (WhatsApp/iMessage bots) so nobody needs to install anything.

attempts.notes: Google's trip planner app, closed August 2019; folded into a website.

reasons.detail: Infrequent use: People take one or two group trips a year.
